answer.says: Ramesh, the day is almost done. I have no money in my pocket that is mine to give you, only the state's imprest which requires vouchers I cannot yet produce. But the ethical life of this household requires that you eat. Go to Khan Market; buy what you need for tonight, and bring the chit. I will regularize it with the Directorate. Do not let the hunger in my belly be the reason for the hunger in yours.
answer.thought: The system of needs is active even when the legal form is suspended; I must bridge the gap between my moral duty and my legal impotence. The state has failed me in its provision, so I must act as a provisional state of my own to maintain the ethical bond with my servant. It is a small act, but the universal must be preserved in the particular.
